svg.title: Flight software architecture: subsystem apps and core services on one bus
svg.desc: Composition root build_apps constructs ten runnables and one MessageBus. Apps publish and subscribe on the bus. Apps do not call each other. The composition root injects HAL drivers and the storage writer.
svg.text: flight.core.composition.build_apps · constructs the bus, clock, drivers, and apps
Apps do not call each other.
in-process pub/sub · routing by exact message class · composition root injects Subscription handles
<<protocol>> HAL · injected by the composition root · not the bus
publish - app places a message on the bus
subscribe - app receives messages of one type from the bus
injected IO / HAL - constructor argument, not a bus channel (storage writer, HAL Protocols)
Every inter-app line ends on MessageBus. HeartbeatMsg comes from the nine monitored runnables.
FaultApp is not monitored. ProcessedFrameMsg stays inside PayloadApp and is not on the bus.
